Sofia R.: Hey team — NimbusOps sent INV-9031 for Sep work (subscription + onboarding hours) but the PDF has no PO number. It's flagged in AP as held. Anyone know the PO or who can sign off on onboarding hours?
Tom H.: I think subscription should match PO 2024-NIM-14, but onboarding (one-off) wasn't covered there. Invoice shows 20 onboarding hours at $150/hr, line item labeled 'implementation'.
Jin K.: Cost owner for onboarding is Tom H. / Product Integrations. Tom, can you confirm approval and GL coding please? We need text in Concur or attached approval for AP.
Tom H.: I approve the onboarding charges. Please attach this exact note: "Tom H. approves NimbusOps INV-9031 onboarding hours, GL=6220, cost center=INT-PLAT." I'll paste to the invoice record now.
Elaine (AP): Good. AP requires the PO for the subscription lines to auto-match. If PO 2024-NIM-14 exists and covers Sep, we can auto-release subscription. Otherwise we need a PO amendment. Also confirm whether onboarding should be split across two GLs per their CSV (looks like 100% to 6220 here).
Sofia R.: Uploaded Tom's approval note to the invoice comments and attached the vendor CSV. Line items in CSV show subscription amount $5,000 and onboarding $3,000.
finance-bot: Invoice INV-9031 status: "held-no-po" -> "manual-review". Assigned approver: Tom H.
Elaine (AP): Tom — can you confirm period coverage for PO 2024-NIM-14? If it covers Sep 2024 AP will route subscription payment.
Tom H.: Confirmed PO 2024-NIM-14 covers Jul-Sep 2024. I attached the PO PDF to the invoice record. Subscription matched to PO 2024-NIM-14; onboarding approved by note.
Elaine (AP): Thanks. Marking INV-9031 ready for payment in next run. ETA: 2 business days. Added GL coding 100% -> 6220. Closing hold.
Sofia R.: Thanks — I'll ask vendor to include PO number on future invoices header (PO 2024-NIM-14) and request they stop embedding line CSVs separately.
Tom H.: Will follow up with vendor ops lead to add PO on header.
Jin K.: Closing. If AP hits any mismatch I'll reopen.
